finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Says one tyrant to another,” Villy countered.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Only if you’re not part of the in-group. Sure, for everyone else, it sucks, but as the ones in power, we benefit, so who cares?” the Primordial said, and at this point, the joke was beginning to feel a bit too real.
